fields.name: RecordException
fields.label: Record Exception
fields.formulaExpression:
case 
when (current(EVENT_TYPE) = 'LightningPageView' OR current(EVENT_TYPE) = 'LightningInteraction') AND (lag(EVENT_TYPE) = 'ApexExecution' OR lag(EVENT_TYPE) = 'ApexTrigger' OR lead(EVENT_TYPE) = 'ApexExecution' OR lead(EVENT_TYPE) = 'ApexTrigger') AND (lag("Exceptions.RowCount")=1 OR lead("Exceptions.RowCount")=1) then 1 else 0 end

fields.name: ComponentNameTemp
fields.label: Component Name
fields.formulaExpression:
case 
when "CustomDataDictionary.Event_Label" != '' then "CustomDataDictionary.Event_Label"  
when (EVENT_TYPE = 'ApexExecution' OR EVENT_TYPE = 'ApexTrigger') AND "ApexDataDictionary.Event_Label" != '' then "ApexDataDictionary.Event_Label" 
when (EVENT_TYPE = 'ApexExecution' OR EVENT_TYPE = 'ApexTrigger') then COMPONENT_NAME 
when EVENT_TYPE = 'LightningPageView' then PageName 
else ComponentName 
end

TRANSFORM0.label: ComputeLightningInteractions1
TRANSFORM0.description: A series of transformatinos to the LightningInteraction event logs.  Some columns are used directly in the dashboards; some are used in later compute expressions.

TRANSFORM1.label: ComputeRelativeLightningInteraction1
TRANSFORM1.description:
Compute some additional values using the multi-row (windowing) functions, based on both the Data Dictionary and previous Compute node.
Note order of case statement for Component Name derivation.

FILTER1.label: FilterNonUserClicks
FILTER1.description: Temporarily filter out the non-user clicks events.

FILTER2.label: FilterUserClicks
FILTER2.description: Filter the user-driven click events, page views and Apex executions.

TRANSFORM2.label: ComputeRelativeLightningInteraction2
TRANSFORM2.description: We compute the time taken to perform a click (Time to Action) and the time spent before another click was made (Stall Time).

APPEND0.label: JoinClicksAndNonClicks
APPEND0.description: Bring all the Lightning Interactions back together.

APPEND2.label: AppendUIAndApex
APPEND2.description: Joining Apex logs with UI logs is experimental. How do you map a class name and method to a page name or SObject? See documentation for an explanation of the mapping. In short, it's down to preference.

FILTER3.label: FilterApexLogs
FILTER3.description: Asyncrhonous Apex logs do not have a session or userId (they are executed by the message queue), and so we can't calculate the time when a user executed it, so removing it.

JOIN2.label: JoinApexCustomDD
JOIN2.description: Enrich Apex Logs with custom data dictionary entries

JOIN3.label: JoinCustomDataDictionary
JOIN3.description: For org-specific UI events such as custom tabs on Lightning record pages.

FILTER4.label: FilterNonDocumentedEvents
FILTER4.description: Remove any events that are not documented. Primarily focused on Apex methods. (Events in Apex typically have a higher cadence impacting Stall and Time to Action).

TRANSFORM5.label: APEX Adjustments
TRANSFORM5.description: For Apex logs to inherit the preceding rows' Lightning UI properties (page name, etc)

LOAD_DATASET8.label: BVA Lightning Page Views and Interactions Adoption

TRANSFORM5_copy0.label: APEX Adjustments 2
TRANSFORM5_copy0.description: Same as APEX Adjustments but repeating for two concurrent Apex logs
